collect_openpose_keypoints: run the script to collect OpenPose body, face, and hand keypoints from a video sequence into a pickle file
parse_openpose_json_keypoints: parse OpenPose JSON output files to extract 2D pose, hand, and face keypoints for each frame
map_body25_to_body19: map the 25-point OpenPose body keypoint format down to a 19-point subset by filtering indices
save_keypoints_pickle: save collected body, left hand, right hand, and face keypoints along with calibration data as a pickle file
load_calibration_data: load camera calibration data from a calib.json file in the sequence root directory
